_lisezmoi: Every statutory figure used by the site lives here, never hard-coded in a page (RECETTE §4, §17.4). Each value was read at the official source named in `sources` on `retrieved_at`. Next review: the April 2027 uprating (Employment Rights (Increase of Limits) Orders, Social Security Benefits Up-rating Orders, HMRC rates and thresholds 2027 to 2028).

redundancy._source: Employment Rights (Increase of Limits) Order 2026 (SI 2026/310), Schedule, s.227(1) ERA 1996; NI: SR 2026/57, art. 23(1) ERNIO 1996. The cap that applies is the one in force on the relevant date (art. 4 transitional provisions).

redundancyExtra._source: Read 2026-10-05. Guarantee pay: ERA 1996 s.31 as amended by SI 2026/310 (GB) and SR 2026/57 art. 63(1) row (NI), both £41 from 6 April 2026. Lay-off and short time: ERA 1996 ss.148-153. Renewal and trial period: ss.138, 141. Time off to look for work: ss.52-53. Collective consultation: TULRCA 1992 ss.188, 189 (protective award up to 180 days from 6 April 2026, ERA 2025 s.30(2), SI 2026/323), 193. Redundancy protected period: SI 2024/264 (GB).

termination._source: ITEPA 2003 s.403 (first £30,000 of a termination award exempt); HMRC rates and thresholds 2026 to 2027 (Class 1A at 15% on termination awards above £30,000).

notice._source: Employment Rights Act 1996 s.86; Employment Rights (Northern Ireland) Order 1996 art. 118 (same scale).

holiday._source: Working Time Regulations 1998 regs 13, 13A, 14, 15A, 15B, 16, 16A (GB); Working Time Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2016; gov.uk Holiday entitlement guide.

familyPay._source: HMRC Rates and thresholds for employers 2026 to 2027 (updated 1 September 2026); Social Security Benefits Up-rating Order 2026 (SI 2026/148) arts 9-10; NI: SR 2026/59 arts 9-10.
familyPay._rateChange: The new SMP/SAP/ShPP/SPP rate starts with the first pay week beginning on or after the first Sunday in April (5 April 2026), the method used by HMRC's own calculator.

ssp._source: Employment Rights Act 2025 ss.10-13, in force 6 April 2026 (SI 2026/373); SSCBA 1992 s.157(1) as amended; Up-rating Order 2026 art. 8 (GB) and SR 2026/59 art. 8 (NI); HMRC Rates and thresholds 2026 to 2027 daily-rate tables.

minimumWage._source: HMRC Rates and thresholds 2026 to 2027 (rates from 1 April 2026). Used only as a floor check for hourly inputs.

familyExtra._source: GOV.UK maternity, paternity, Maternity Allowance and shared parental guides and employer guides (read 2026-10-05); HMRC Statutory Payments Manual SPM171000-SPM172200, SPM182600, SPM200100-SPM200600; SMP (General) Regulations 1986 reg. 21; Paternity Leave (Amendment) Regulations 2024 (SI 2024/329); Employment Rights Act 2025 ss.16-17; nidirect Maternity Allowance and SMP eligibility.

holidayExtra._source: Working Time Regulations 1998 regs 13(3), 13(15), 15A(3), 15B(5), 15D(4), 15F (legislation.gov.uk, read 2026-10-05); SI 2023/1426 reg 1(2) (in force 1 January 2024, extent England and Wales and Scotland for Part 2); nidirect, Taking your holidays (Northern Ireland, read 2026-10-05).

leavingExtra._source: Employment Rights Act 1996 ss.86(4), 87-91, 212(4), 226, 227 and 230; Employment Rights (Northern Ireland) Order 1996 arts 23, 118, 140, 190, 197 (legislation.gov.uk, read 2026-10-05); GOV.UK Agency workers: your rights (12-week qualifying period, breaks of 6 weeks or less); nidirect Redundancy pay (lay-off 6 weeks in 13); HMRC EIM13505 and EIM12975 (post-employment notice pay from 6 April 2018).
